home.title: Home
home.description: A summary of your workspace and your access.

pending.body: This section will be enabled in the next console release.

apiKeys.description: Create, review and revoke the keys your systems use to call the API.

revoke.title: Revoke the key “{{name}}”?

scopes.customHint: Format area:read or area:write, for example: reports:read.

secret.title: Key “{{name}}” created
secret.hint: Copy it and store it somewhere safe now. For security, it cannot be viewed again.

disable.conflict: You cannot disable your own account.

create.title: New user
create.description: An initial password is generated and shown only once; the person must change it when they first sign in.

secret.title: Initial password for {{name}}
secret.hint: Share it with {{email}} through a secure channel. They must change it on their first sign-in. For security, it cannot be viewed again.

legalHold.confirmSet: While the legal hold is on, this party is not purged even after its retention period ends.

pep.RCA: Relative or close associate of a PEP

edit.nationalitiesHint: Two-letter codes separated by commas, for example MX, US.

documents.title: Documents
documents.file: File (PDF, JPEG or PNG, up to 25 MB)

customer.title: Customer relationships
customer.confirmClose: Ending the relationship starts the retention period of this person's or company's data, under the policy in force.

audit.title: Audit
audit.description: Browse the event log and verify the integrity of its chain.

valid.title: Chain intact
valid.body: The whole chain was walked: every event matches its hash and the event before it.

empty.title: Chain is empty
empty.body: There are no audit events yet, so there is nothing to verify. This is not a failure.

broken.title: Chain broken
broken.body: Verification found an inconsistency. Review the event indicated and escalate the case to your security team.
broken.entriesChecked: Events checked up to the failure

reason.sequence: An event is missing or a sequence number is repeated.
reason.prevHash: The previous hash does not match the preceding event.
reason.content: The event's content does not match its hash.
reason.unknown: Verification failed for a reason this console does not recognize.

audit.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard

empty.none: There are no audit events yet.

security.title: Security
security.description: Manage two-step verification and your account password.

totp.title: Two-step verification
totp.description: On top of your password, signing in will ask for a temporary code (TOTP) from your authenticator app.
totp.onBody: Your account already asks for a code from your authenticator app when you sign in.
totp.offBody: Your account is protected by its password alone. Turn it on with an app such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password.
totp.scanBody: Open your authenticator app and scan this code.
totp.qrLabel: QR code to set up your authenticator app
totp.manualBody: Type this key into your app as a time-based key.
totp.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard
totp.onceTitle: This key is shown only once
totp.onceBody: It cannot be looked up again. If you cancel or leave this page, you will have to start the setup over.
totp.codeHint: The 6 to 8 digit code your app shows.
totp.codeInvalid: That code is not correct. Check it in your app (and that your device's clock is right) and try again.
totp.alreadyEnabled: Two-step verification was already active on your account.
totp.successBody: From now on, signing in will ask for the code from your app.

password.title: Change password
password.description: Choose a new password of at least 12 characters. Your current session stays open.

boot.errorTitle: Your session could not be loaded

errors.generic: An unexpected error occurred. Try again.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session is not valid or has expired. Sign in again.
errors.ROLE_FORBIDDEN: Your role is not allowed to perform this action.
errors.SCOPE_MISSING: The credential does not include the permission this operation needs.
errors.TENANT_SUSPENDED: The workspace is suspended. Contact your administrator.
errors.PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED: You must change your password before continuing.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to perform this action.
errors.NOT_FOUND: We could not find what you were looking for.
errors.CONFLICT: The operation conflicts with the current state. Refresh and try again.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED: The request is missing its idempotency key.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: This request was already sent with different data. Start again.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS: The previous request is still being processed. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Check the data you entered: some values are not valid.
errors.INTERNAL: An internal error occurred. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.CONNECTOR_NO_ROUTE: No connector serves this check in this country.
errors.UNIT_VALUE_MISSING: The unit's value for that date is missing, and nothing fills it in silently. Try again once it is published.
errors.POLICY_NOT_ASSIGNED: No policy pack is assigned for that date and product.
errors.POLICY_LOOSENING: The override would loosen the policy: only overrides stricter than the pack are allowed.
errors.IDENTIFIER_EXISTS: A party with that identifier already exists.
errors.IDENTIFIER_INVALID: The identifier is not valid for its type.
errors.OBJECT_CORRUPT: The stored file failed its integrity check. Tell support.
